def shortestPalindrome(s: str) -> str:
    if not s:
        return s
    rev = s[::-1]
    combined = s + '#' + rev
    lps = [0] * len(combined)
    for i in range(1, len(combined)):
        j = lps[i - 1]
        while j > 0 and combined[i] != combined[j]:
            j = lps[j - 1]
        if combined[i] == combined[j]:
            j += 1
        lps[i] = j
    max_pal = lps[-1]
    return rev[:len(s) - max_pal] + s
